sources.entry: EDA - Web application for data analysis and visualization. AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Edalitics (formerly Enterprise Data Analytics, repo EDA) is an open-source analytics and dashboarding platform from Jortilles for building data models and reports without code.
summary.what_it_does: Edalitics is a metadata-driven analytics tool where users first create a data model and then build reports and dashboards on top of it. It offers no-code dashboard creation, an advanced SQL query mode, and a tree mode for exploring logical data models. Users can define KPIs with automatic e-mail alerts and share public dashboards via URL. It includes Row Level Security (RLS) for controlling data access. Metadata and configuration are stored in MongoDB, with a Node.js/TypeScript backend and an Angular frontend.
use_cases: explore data through a logical data model
write and run SQL queries for reports
set KPI alerts sent by e-mail
restrict data access per user with row-level security
how_to_run: cd EDA/eda/eda_api && npm install && npm start
cd EDA/eda/eda_app && npm install && npm start
notable: Metadata-driven: define a data model first, then create reports on it
Advanced SQL query mode alongside no-code dashboard building
Row Level Security (RLS) for controlled data access
Docker image available for quick start with default credentials
caveats: Local deployment requires manually configuring MongoDB connection and backend URL in source files
Default credentials (eda@jortilles.com / default) must be changed for any real use
README does not state which SQL databases are supported
